name: arranging-customer-local-practicum
description: Use when contract for shadow work, supervised practice, or independent demonstration at the customer's boundary.
preconditions: the exact customer, candidate, source, or Academy record in scope resolves
the acting office's authority and refusal boundary are explicit
required evidence is available or its absence is recorded
an original FormationRequest, Enrollment, FormationBaseline, customer office epoch and source-owned Work identity are resolved before field practice
the actual customer officer records a bounded observation or simulation grant, protected-context and egress terms, stop conditions, budget, and a separate eligible examiner
a live practitioner Session, installed and available provider, and customer-owned operation permission are evidenced before any real customer effect; missing material yields a typed refusal
the placement has one lawful positive case plus risk-relevant denial, interruption, replay, or handoff controls grounded in its real provider contract

the WIT source event, customer-owned ACK admission or explicit refusal, independently retained source selection and permitted ATT operation are separately identified without inventing a new Work or a live Session
a canonical Work subject is attached only after genuine source-owned admission; a repository label, candidate claim or prior promise cannot substitute for the original Work intent
postconditions: one field placement whose practice is real and whose authority remains customer-owned
no customer appointment, capability grant, or cross-settlement write is performed
the original customer Work identity and prior event/effect head survive interruption, refusal and replay without duplicate Work or an unlicensed side effect
every admitted TrainingEvent is tied to the exact enrollment, baseline, bundle and candidate identity and carries digest-verifiable evidence, a declared outcome and customerMutation false
an independent examiner receives complete case-level evidence for the existing assessing-a-candidate process without the practitioner issuing an Assessment or Qualification
source, session, operation and beneficiary receiving remain separate observed states, with missing and contradictory evidence preserved

each event-driven practice case preserves WIT, ACK, ATT or withheld-ATT evidence, its original Work and stable independent selection; changing the candidate cannot also rewrite the receiver's expected source
a misbound Work taking can be recovered by one authorized historical release and a new subject-free taking on the same original Work without rewriting evidence or double-promising

records: one field placement whose practice is real and whose authority remains customer-owned
source-qualified FormationRequest, Enrollment, FormationBaseline, customer Office and original Work identities
customer-granted practice and observation bounds, provider contract, available executor and Session witness or typed refusal
TrainingEvent evidence artifacts and digests, case IDs, interruption and replay comparison, customerMutation false, or existing FormationRefusal
independent customer-operation effect/denial receipt and handoff for a separately authored Assessment

source-pinned WIT event, customer admission/refusal ACK, independently selected source, positive and alias-substitution negative controls, actual permitted ATT or withheld effect and separate beneficiary receiving
source-pinned Work-Arena promise/attach refusal, lawful historical release and re-promise receipts, independent active-taking readback and unresolved execution-obligation obstacle
